source.supporting_file: S1 File: Additional details of population count data

reason: The frozen primary endpoint requires paired standardized historical and recent abundance at each of 99 sites. S1 contains the site roster/coordinates, regional growth summaries, and regional time series, but not the 99 paired site-level abundance estimates. No substitute endpoint is introduced after opening S1.
allowed_next_step: A separate pre-effect contract may specify a different public source containing site-level abundance before those values are inspected.
